exposure: postpartum depression (PPD) at 1 and 6 months postpartum
infant feeding practices (initiation of weaning food)
outcome: child's BMI z-score at 1 and 3 years of age
cohort: This study assessed 1,279 mother-child dyads from a larger cohort recruited between May 2010 and November 2013 at the National Center for Child Health and Development (NCCHD) in suburban Tokyo, Japan.
finding: Children at 3 years whose mothers experienced postpartum depression at 6 months postpartum had a significantly higher BMI z-score, and early initiation of weaning food at six months was also associated with a higher child BMI z-score at 3 years.
